notes: After an early R&D dig it ran HQ into the same unbreakable Hagen about 20 times over six turns, never building economy past 5 credits. The Vitruvius advances in the remote went entirely uncontested.
Scored safely out of one iced remote, but iced six empty remotes for no purpose and repeatedly clicked for credits or drew into discards while sitting on 15-27 credits.

Hoarded credits from 15 to 37 for eight turns while Obokata was advanced over three turns uncontested. On the final run it paid for Engolo on Anansi and then failed to break it despite 35 credits, which led to the flatline.

After three Breaking News it stopped scoring entirely, drew 3 per turn into 4-card discards, dumped Project Beales into an unprotected Archives (both stolen) and finally decked itself while holding 28 credits.

After an early free steal it clicked for credits for about seven turns with 20+ credits, never touching a 12-card HQ with one ice or contesting two agendas left advanced overnight in the remote; it replayed Levy instead of running on the final turn.
Solid and simple: IP Block locked R&D, the remote was iced, and agendas were installed and scored on a steady cadence; only minor draw-into-discard and an empty-remote ice install.

The Paparazzi plus Data Leak Reversal mill into Archives was a coherent winning plan. It also ran R&D through Resistor with Eater roughly ten times, which by Eater's own text accesses nothing, and it sat on 20 credits into Closed Accounts.
Clicked for credits every click for about fourteen turns, reaching 71 credits with a full grip, and never ran while the Corp installed and scored 7 points across several remotes.

Early scoring from a well-iced remote was fine. It then spent about five full turns looping Archived Memories back into Archived Memories with 16 credits instead of drawing for agendas, and still clicked for credits while rich.
Discarded three Project Atlases into a never-iced Archives, all stolen, while sitting on 20-36 credits clicking for credits; it landed Hard-Hitting News but never punished the tags.

Shipment from Tennin fast-advances were good, but it idled many turns clicking for credits at 20-34 credits, then put Elective Upgrade in a fresh one-ice remote, where it was stolen, instead of the stacked Server 1, and repeated the same exposure next turn.

Won on early R&D luck plus HQ steals, with a reasonable economy. It still ran into Magnet about six times without being able to break it, wasted 6 credits on Black Orchestra copies that broke nothing, and never contested the one-ice remote where the Corp scored 4 points.

Won, but let Vitruvius and Global Food Initiative end up in an unprotected Archives (both stolen). It installed Efficiency Committee behind the Gatekeeper the Runner had broken four times already, and wasted clicks looping Archived Memories.

Won through Archives and R&D steals. Against Personal Evolution it repeatedly let Yagura's net damage fire with 22 credits and Passport available, flirting with flatline, and wasted Legwork and Account Siphon on a rezzed Eli it could not break.

Re-ran the same known Urtica Cipher trap in an unprotected remote seven times, discarding three cards each time and shredding its own deck and rig, while never contesting the remote where the Corp scored every agenda.

Repeatedly installed agendas in naked remotes: one Fetal AI was stolen, another survived only by luck. Mushin No Shin went into a new unprotected server and lost House of Knives, and it never added a second ice to R&D despite 25 turns of R&D pressure.

Emptied its own stack early with MaxX and Zer0, and threw credits away on Paperclip and Black Orchestra re-installs that broke nothing. It then clicked for credits to 25 while Vitruvius and Ikawah were advanced overnight in the remote without a single contest.

Reasonable Anansi and net-damage plan that flatlined the Runner. It lost Obokata from a 3-ice remote because it was too poor to rez after Mlinzi, and it had some draw-into-discard and idle credit clicks.
Efficient: Funhouse taxed R&D, Retribution hit Carmen, and it scored 7 points out of a one-ice remote against a broke Runner; it never punished the heavy tag load, but may not have had the cards.

Stimhacked an empty Archives, cutting its own hand size. It then spent 20 turns drawing two cards into a forced discard while banking 47 credits, never contested any of the three AR-Enhanced Security scores, and won only because the Corp decked.
